problems.reason: Both sentences state that Mystriosuchus was first named by Eberhard Fraas in 1896.
Sentence 16 limits the temporal range to the Late Triassic (middle Norian), while sentence 17 extends it from the Norian to the Hettangian (227.3–199.5 Ma), which includes the Early Jurassic.

Sentence 12 places Mystriosuchus in the subfamily Pseudopalatinae, whereas sentence 15 states that Pseudopalatinae was synonymized with Mystriosuchini, implying a different taxonomic rank and priority.

notes: - contradiction: "Mystriosuchus lived in Europe and Greenland during the Late Triassic (middle Norian)." / "Mystriosuchus lived from the Norian to the Hettangian, between 227.3 and 199.5 million years ago.": Sentence 16 limits the temporal range to the Late Triassic (middle Norian), while sentence 17 extends it from the Norian to the Hettangian (227.3–199.5 Ma), which includes the Early Jurassic.

- contradiction: "Mystriosuchus is classified within the subfamily Pseudopalatinae." / "Christian Kammerer and colleagues synonymized Pseudopalatinae with Mystriosuchini because the latter has priority.": Sentence 12 places Mystriosuchus in the subfamily Pseudopalatinae, whereas sentence 15 states that Pseudopalatinae was synonymized with Mystriosuchini, implying a different taxonomic rank and priority.
